items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: I was wondering if that was Freddie Kepin.

ctx.x: Charlie McCurdy. Right. Right. That's who that would be, Charlie McCurdy. Now this fella playing trumpet, I don't know if that could be Freddie Kepin. I was wondering if that was Freddie Kepin.

Yeah, Kimball was supposed to be. It's too bad, I should have had a copy of this. I interviewed Norv and Henry Kimball, Henry Kimball Jr., some people call him. Because his father is a bass player, Henry Kimball. He used to play on the boat with Fade Marable and all.
